Bearer.description: JWT access token. Send it as: Authorization: Bearer <token>.

get.description: Filter by status (All, Active, Inactive, Expired) and q (part of the code).

post.description: maxUsesPerUser is optional (the store setting Coupon.MaxUsesPerUserDefault when missing). startsAt and endsAt are a date (2026-01-15) or a date with a time. An endsAt date alone means the end of that day in Cairo; a startsAt date alone means its start.

delete.description: A soft delete: the uses and the orders keep their history and the usages list still works. A coupon used at the same moment can answer 409 coupon_concurrency_conflict.

get.description: The coupon with its statistics and the rowVersion (base64) for the next update.

put.description: A full replace. rowVersion (base64) is the one the details route returned. Every use of the coupon changes its rowVersion, so a coupon that is being used answers 409 coupon_concurrency_conflict: reload it and send again. A maxUsesTotal below the uses so far answers 422 coupon_total_below_used.

patch.description: Switches the coupon on or off. If the coupon is used at the same moment the answer can be 409 coupon_concurrency_conflict: send it again.

get.description: Who used the coupon, in which order and for how much, newest first. Page size 1 to 100.

post.description: Returns 201 with the whole cart when a new line was created. When the quantity was merged into an existing line the status is 200 with the same body. A 409 stock_insufficient problem carries availableQuantity.

Read only: prices the current cart for an address or a shipping zone and an optional coupon. Nothing is reserved, used or stored. Send exactly one of addressId and zoneId. zone.shippingFee is the base price of the zone; the top-level shippingFee is the fee actually charged (0 when free shipping applies).
